title: docs(adr,spec): ADR-0084's notes catch up with the knowledge_source row; the knowledge_source tombstones name the code door
body:
Fixes #37740
Fixes #37741

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：从旧版升级、在代码里注册知识源的开发者，碰到旧写法的报错时，提示会先说明“直接改代码里那处注册”，再提迁移命令；旧名字以下划线开头的知识源改名后会留下一份旧索引，升级说明现在写明它为什么留下、怎么删。应用搭建菜单的架构决策记录（ADR-0084）里，几处统计和说明补上了表里已有的“知识源”一行，菜单本身不变。
- 为什么做：知识平台专题里“知识源成为受管元数据类型”那次合并，审核留下两条小尾巴：升级提示指向一个对代码注册不起作用的命令，架构记录的说明没跟上表格。这次替升级的开发者和读记录的人补齐。
- 出错会怎样：只改提示文字和文档，不改任何行为、数据和菜单；文字写错最多是提示不准，直接撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：这个 PR 改了受管文档（架构决策记录 ADR-0084 的几处说明），审核通过后请你批准合并。

## What changes

Two cards from one contract record (the review of the change that made `knowledge_source` a governed type): its nit N2 is #37740, its nit N5 is #37741. Text only: no schema shape, no behaviour, no menu row.

### #37740 — ADR-0084's notes read true for the table as it stands (governed, `docs/adr/**`)

The table has held a `knowledge_source` row since that change (AI, order 5, 高级). The prose around the table still described it without that row. Five places, each amended in the record's own dated form, struck text kept:

1. **The note under the table** gains one dated paragraph: the registry read again at `origin/main` `62dd9e1ef5` holds 35 entries — the 33 of the two earlier readings and two registered on 2026-11-27, `form` (`ui`) and `knowledge_source` (`ai`); `form` has no row yet, so the table has 34 rows; AI counts 5.
2. **The fold sentence** ("its label is drawn again inside the fold only where a package holds an `ai_context`") gains a dated note: AI holds two 高级 types, so either one draws the label.
3. **The 2026-11-25 amendment's table row** ("One row is new: `ai_context`") gains a dated note: a second row has been written under item 6 since.
4. **Item 6**: the heading names both types (the old heading struck, not deleted), and the item ends with a dated note that says what changed for `ai_context`'s row (fourth, no longer last in AI) and how the same three ruled sentences place `knowledge_source`.
5. **The sentence that introduces the table** ("*(33 at the 2026-11-25 reading, in the note under the table)*") now also points at the 2026-11-27 reading. This fifth place is not in the card's list of four; it is the same stale count one paragraph up, so it is brought along here rather than left to contradict the note it points at. The claim's file surface names four places: it wants this one added.

The card says "33 entries"; the registry holds 35, because `form` was registered the same day (hidden from Studio's directory, no row). The note says 35 and says why the table has 34 rows.

Nothing is decided: the row, its order and its tier were written by the earlier change under item 6, and `studioMenuPlacement.ts` already mirrors them. No Status line changes.

### #37741 — the `knowledge_source` tombstones say what the author of a registration in code does (`packages/spec`)

- **The prescriptions.** Each retired-key prescription that ends with `os migrate meta --from 18` (`id`, `source.contentFields`, `embedding`, `vectorStore`, `adapterConfig`, `refresh.cron`, and the `'*'` member of `source.content`) now first says: a source registered in code (`KnowledgeServicePlugin({ sources })`, `registerSource`) is in no stack collection, so the command lists no edit for it, and the edit is made in the registration itself. One constant, `CODE_DOOR_18`, placed before the migrate sentence, which stays the last sentence of its prescription (the house pin). The prescription for a retired source kind (`file`, `http`) is unchanged: it sends nobody to the command.
- **The ADR-0087 D3 entry** `knowledge-source-registration-governed` (the entry `os migrate meta --from 18` prints) now states the one exception to "nothing is rebuilt": a source whose 18 `id` began with an underscore. A `name` must start with a letter, so that source is renamed; an adapter keys what it holds by the source's name, so the renamed source is built from nothing under its new name and the adapter keeps the index it built under the old id; the service never drops that index (it drops one only for a `knowledge_source` item it stops serving). The entry says how it is dropped: `dropSource({ source })` on the adapter (`IKnowledgeService.getAdapter`) with `name` set to the old id, or in the adapter's own store where the adapter has no `dropSource`.
- **Pins.** `knowledge-source.test.ts`: each of the six tombstones and the `'*'` message must name both spellings of the code door and "in the registration itself", each before the sentence that names the command.
- **Generated.** `check:generated` found one artifact stale after the tombstone change (`content/docs/references/**`), and `--fix` rewrote one page of it: `content/docs/references/ai/knowledge-source.mdx`.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Tests

All on head `4f6792529c`, in one hold of the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`), unless a line says otherwise.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — exit 0: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — exit 0: `Test Files 909 passed (909)`, `Tests 28748 passed | 1 todo (28749)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` — exit 0: `Tests 19 passed (19)`. This is the test that parses the ADR's table rows; no row changes here.

<details>
<summary>Ablation (one): the new pin goes red when one tombstone loses the code-door sentence</summary>

Run on `df045b9f8b`. The two files it involves have the same blobs on the final head: `knowledge-source.zod.ts` `0d433e77468e`, `knowledge-source.test.ts` `56ebce2f5d4e`.

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the `+ CODE_DOOR_18` line of one tombstone (`adapterConfig`) replaced by an empty-string term. Direction set before the run: that row red, every other test green.

- landed: `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 0d433e77468e -> 8a47142baebf`; `+ CODE_DOOR_18` lines on disk during the run: 6 (7 before).
- result: exit 1, `Tests 1 failed | 31 passed (32)`. The one failure is the row "`adapterConfig` is refused at its own path with its prescription, the code door and the migrate sentence": ``AssertionError: `KnowledgeServicePlugin({ sources })` is named: expected -1 to be greater than -1``.
- restored: ``ok restored: blob == HEAD (0d433e77468e) and `git diff HEAD` is empty``; 7 lines again. The full suite above ran after it.

The first attempt measured nothing and is void: its replacement text was a prefix of the anchor, so the tool refused it ("the replacement count moved 1 -> 1, a rise of 0, not the declared 1") and restored without running the test. The replacement was changed and the ablation run once more.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Probe (one-off, not committed): an underscore-led id leaves its index behind, and dropSource removes it</summary>

A test file placed in `packages/plugins/knowledge-memory` for the run and removed after it (`git status` clean, checked by the same script). It reads the schema and the memory adapter:

- `KnowledgeSourceSchema.safeParse` of a source named `_kb` is refused, at path `name` alone; the same source named `kb` parses.
- an index built under `_kb`, then the source built under `kb`: `old key holds ["article:1"] new key holds ["article:1"]`.
- `dropSource` with the source's `name` set to `_kb`: `old key holds [] new key holds ["article:1"]`.
- exit 0, `Tests 1 passed (1)`.

Two earlier attempts measured nothing and are void: the first imported the service and stopped on a workspace package that was not built; the second read a field the listing does not have.

The service's half is pinned by landed tests and was not run again here: "unregisterSource removes a source registered in code and keeps its index" (`service-knowledge`, `knowledge-source-registry.test.ts`) and the adapter contract suite's `dropSource` block.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **"The ADR-0087 D3 entry" is a registry entry, not text in ADR-0087.** The claim's file surface and its `Container & model` line name `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`. That file holds no `knowledge_source` text (`grep -c knowledge`: 0; control `grep -c D3`: 19). The D3 entry the card means is `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.knowledge-source-registration-governed.ts`, which is what this PR edits. ADR-0087 is not touched; the PR is governed through ADR-0084 alone.
- **The underscore fact was read in code before it was written**, then run once (the probe above). The readers: `name` takes `ROUTER_ADDRESSABLE_NAME_PATTERN` (a letter first) where the 18 `id` pattern admitted a leading underscore; every adapter keys by `AdapterContext.source.name`; `KnowledgeService.unregisterSource` leaves the index with its adapter and `dropMetadataSource` runs only for a metadata item; the scheduled reconcile that landed on `main` meanwhile walks registered sources only; the three adapters in the tree (memory, pgvector, turso) implement `dropSource`, which the contract leaves optional.
- **The entry does not list what starts the build of the renamed source.** `main` gained a third moment (the scheduled reconcile) while this branch was open, so the sentence says what the build costs instead: every record the source covers is read, and on an adapter that embeds the content fields of each are sent to the embedding provider again.
- **Not changed, on purpose:** the `id` tombstone still says "the value is unchanged, so the source's index is found again and is not rebuilt". That holds for every id that is a legal name; for an underscore-led id the parse refuses the value next, with the name grammar's own message, and the D3 entry carries the rest. The card asks for the exception in the entry, not in the tombstone.
- **Seen, not changed here, no card:** the changeset of the earlier change (`.changeset/37304-knowledge-source-governed-type.md`) and the hand-written `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` say the index is found again, without the underscore exception. Both are right for an id that is a legal name. An edit to a landed changeset is a deliberate correction with its own declaration, so it is left for the seat to place.
- **Neighbour #37945 (the `datasource` row)** rewrote the same note block of ADR-0084 and landed first. `main` was merged twice: at `62dd9e1ef5` (one conflict, in that block: its note kept first, this PR's note after it, reworded for the table as it then stood) and at `9a274e6725` (clean). `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before each push; on the final head: `VERDICT clean exit 0`, 0 PR heads.
- **Neighbour #37306** edits `knowledge-source.zod.ts` at the `adapter` line, about ten lines from this PR's nearest edits on either side. It has no open PR at this writing.
- **Not measured locally, declared:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`, which the derivation names. It spawns the CLI and needs its 71-package dependency closure built; CI runs it. What it pins for this diff was read directly: the entry's four printed fields hold no tracker id (`surface` 279 chars, `replacement` 863, `reason` 2140, `acceptanceCriteria` 648: no match; a control string matches).

## Verification

**Read first (by risk):**

1. `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`, item 6's closing note. The risk hunk is one clause: "its schema requires one object (the `object` key of its `source`, …), so the first test of the rule sorts it 高级". It applies the record's own rule ("Its schema does not require one object") to a type the ruling did not name. The row's tier does not rest on it: the two sentences that follow place the type without it. If the seat reads that clause as more than carrying out, it can be struck and the note still stands.
2. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.knowledge-source-registration-governed.ts`: `replacement`, `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` are what an upgrading author is shown. Check the drop instruction against `packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts` (`dropSource` takes an `AdapterContext`).
3. `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts`: `CODE_DOOR_18` and its seven uses.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/knowledge-source.test.ts` — expect `Tests 32 passed (32)`; six of them are the rows titled "… with its prescription, the code door and the migrate sentence".

**Local gates, on head `4f6792529c`.** Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` with no paths; each command run as printed, its exit code recorded before any pipe; reconciled by `--ran`:

`Run reconciliation — 116 derived, 111 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN.` · `✗ dispatch-gates --ran: 1 of 116 derived famil(ies) UNRUN.`

- **111 run: exit 0, every one.** Among them the families this diff moves: `check:adr-index`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`, `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:role-word`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, and the spec's own `check:generated`, `check:docs`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:liveness`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:spec-changes`.
